description: MUTATES Quaderno data — create a product/item in the catalog. Provide name + unit_cost; use `fields` for any other attribute (code, description, tax_class, tax_type, currency, country, stock). Quaderno API: POST /items. Returns the created item.

fields.description: Additional raw Quaderno fields merged into the request body (escape hatch for any field not typed above).

kind.description: Whether it is a one-off or a subscription product.

product_type.description: Whether the product is a good or a service.

name: create_item
title: Create a product (item)
